name: Open-Meteo Weather Forecast API
summary: Free global weather forecasts, current conditions and historical reanalysis, no API key needed.
description: Hourly, daily and 15-minute weather variables (temperature, precipitation, wind, radiation, cloud cover, soil and more) from national weather service models such as ICON, GFS, ECMWF and Meteo-France, for any coordinate. Sibling hosts cover historical archive (1940-present), marine, air quality, flood, climate projections and elevation.

rate_limit.summary: Free tier for non-commercial use: 600 calls/minute, 5,000/hour, 10,000/day. Commercial use requires a paid plan.

endpoints.summary: Forecast and current conditions for a latitude/longitude

license.name: CC BY 4.0 (data); API free for non-commercial use

coverage.temporal: Forecast up to 16 days (more for some models); archive from 1940

agent_notes: Best first-choice weather API: no key, simple parameters, and units are echoed in the response. Coordinates are snapped to the model grid; request only the variables you need via hourly/daily/current.
caveats: Free tier is non-commercial only; attribution to Open-Meteo is required.
Responses default to GMT unless the timezone parameter is set.
Archive, air-quality, marine and other endpoints live on sibling hostnames, not api.open-meteo.com.
